introduction: ERC-7291 defines a Purpose Bound Money (PBM) interface that extends ERC-1155 to wrap an ERC-20 compatible store-of-value token with rules governing how it may be spent. It was proposed by Orchid-Dev, Victor Liew, and others in June 2023. A PBM wraps an underlying sovToken and releases it only when transfer conditions are met, such as the recipient being a whitelisted merchant and not blacklisted. Once unwrapped, the PBM token is burnt and the underlying money becomes freely spendable again.
designPurpose: ERC-7291 was designed to prevent fragmentation among programmable payment schemes, where each issuer built its own incompatible voucher contract. Government vouchers, conditional disbursements, and escrow milestone payouts all need money that carries spending conditions, yet without a shared interface they cannot move across wallets and rails. By building on ERC-1155 and defining wrap, transfer, unwrap, and revoke semantics around an underlying sovToken, it gives these use cases one interoperable standard.
commonUsage: Purpose Bound Money targets real-world disbursement scenarios: government vouchers redeemable only at approved merchants, conditional payouts released after a verified event, and escrow milestones tied to completed work. The wrapper enforces a whitelist of merchant or redeemer addresses and a blacklist of banned addresses before releasing funds. Because a PBM is an ERC-1155 token, wallets and explorers that support ERC-1155 can hold and display it, while the wrapped sovToken remains an ordinary ERC-20 token.
fn.initialise.desc: Initialises the PBM wrapper by setting the underlying ERC-20 compatible sovToken address, a contract-wide expiry timestamp, and the address of the wrapper logic contract that holds the spending conditions.
fn.initialise.params.sovToken: Address of the underlying ERC-20 compatible sovToken that the PBM wraps.
fn.initialise.params.expiry: Contract-wide expiry timestamp expressed in Unix epoch time.
fn.initialise.params.pbmWrapperLogic: Address of the contract holding the conditions and business logic that govern the PBM.
fn.uri.desc: Returns the ERC-1155 metadata URI for a PBM token type. The URI points to a JSON file conforming to the ERC-1155 Metadata URI JSON Schema and is not expected to be immutable.
fn.uri.params.tokenId: Identifier of the PBM token type being queried.
fn.uri.returns.uri: Metadata URI string for the PBM token type.
fn.safeMint.desc: Creates PBM copies of an existing token type and transfers them to the receiver, pulling the underlying sovToken from the caller into the wrapper. Emits the TokenWrap event as the sovToken is wrapped.
fn.safeMint.params.receiver: Wallet address that receives the newly minted PBM tokens.
fn.safeMint.params.tokenId: Identifier of the PBM token type to copy.
fn.safeMint.params.amount: Number of PBM tokens to create.
fn.safeMint.params.data: Additional data with no specified format, based on ERC-5750.
fn.safeTransferFrom.desc: Transfers a PBM token from one wallet to another. When the recipient is a whitelisted merchant or redeemer, implementations may unwrap the PBM and release the underlying sovToken to that address.
fn.safeTransferFrom.params.from: Account the PBM is moving from.
fn.safeTransferFrom.params.id: Identifier of the PBM token type.
fn.safeTransferFrom.params.amount: Quantity of the PBM token type to transfer.
fn.safeTransferFrom.params.data: Optional data recorded with the transaction; can be left blank.
fn.burn.desc: Destroys the given amount of a PBM token type from an address and handles the underlying wrapped sovToken. Emits TransferSingle, and TokenUnwrapForPBMBurn when the wrapped token is moved out of the contract.
fn.burn.params.from: Wallet address whose PBM tokens are burned.
fn.burn.params.tokenId: Identifier of the PBM token type.
fn.burn.params.amount: Amount of PBM tokens to burn.
fn.burn.params.data: Additional data with no specified format, based on ERC-5750.
fn.revokePBM.desc: Allows the creator of a PBM token type or the contract owner to retrieve all locked-up underlying sovTokens within that PBM. Emits the PBMrevokeWithdraw event on success.
fn.revokePBM.params.tokenId: Identifier of the PBM token type to revoke.
fn.TokenWrap.desc: Emitted when underlying sovTokens are wrapped into the PBM contract, marking the start of the PBM lifecycle. One event is emitted for each underlying token involved.
fn.TokenWrap.params.from: Address initiating the token wrapping process.
fn.TokenWrap.params.tokenIds: Identifiers of the token types being wrapped.
fn.TokenWrap.params.amounts: Quantities of the corresponding wrapped tokens.
fn.TokenWrap.params.sovTokenValue: Amount of wrapped underlying sovTokens transferred.
fn.TokenUnwrapForTarget.desc: Emitted when underlying tokens are unwrapped and transferred to a purpose-bound address, signifying the end of the PBM lifecycle once all conditions are met. One event is emitted per underlying token.
fn.TokenUnwrapForTarget.params.from: Address from which the PBM tokens are unwrapped.
fn.TokenUnwrapForTarget.params.to: Purpose-bound address receiving the unwrapped underlying tokens.
fn.TokenUnwrapForTarget.params.tokenIds: Identifiers of the unwrapped PBM token types.
fn.TokenUnwrapForTarget.params.amounts: Quantities of the corresponding unwrapped PBM tokens.
fn.TokenUnwrapForTarget.params.sovTokenV: Amount of unwrapped underlying sovTokens transferred.
fn.TokenUnwrapForPBMBurn.desc: Emitted when PBM tokens are burned and the underlying tokens are unwrapped for the designated recipient. One event is emitted per underlying token involved in the unwrap.
fn.TokenUnwrapForPBMBurn.params.from: Address from which the PBM tokens are burned.
fn.TokenUnwrapForPBMBurn.params.to: Address receiving the unwrapped underlying tokens.
fn.TokenUnwrapForPBMBurn.params.tokenIds: Identifiers of the burned PBM token types.
fn.TokenUnwrapForPBMBurn.params.amounts: Quantities of the corresponding burned PBM tokens.
fn.TokenUnwrapForPBMBurn.params.sovToken: Amount of unwrapped underlying sovTokens transferred.
fn.PBMrevokeWithdraw.desc: Emitted when a PBM type creator withdraws the underlying sovTokens from the remaining expired PBMs of that type.
fn.PBMrevokeWithdraw.params.beneficiary: Address, the PBM type creator, that receives the sovToken.
fn.PBMrevokeWithdraw.params.PBMTokenId: Identifier of the PBM token type.
sim.redeemWalkthrough.name: PBM Redemption Walkthrough
sim.redeemWalkthrough.desc: Follow a PBM transfer to a whitelisted merchant, where the wrapper unwraps the underlying sovToken and emits the unwrap event.
sim.redeemWalkthrough.step.call: The holder calls safeTransferFrom to send the PBM token to a whitelisted merchant or redeemer address.
sim.redeemWalkthrough.step.execute: The wrapper checks that the recipient is whitelisted and not blacklisted, then burns the transferred PBM and updates balances.
sim.redeemWalkthrough.step.unwrap: The wrapper unwraps the underlying sovToken and transfers it to the merchant, releasing the money for free use.
sim.redeemWalkthrough.step.event: The contract emits TokenUnwrapForTarget so indexers and auditors can record the completed redemption.
